subject: Kickoff: Agile Modeling — concept to classifier in minutes
body:
Hi Alina, team,

Kicking off Agile Modeling. The promise: a user with no ML experience goes from a concept in their head to a working image classifier in minutes. The open-source release includes the end-to-end Colab flow plus all user-labeled data for the 14 concepts from the experiments, which gives us a ready-made regression eval.

Product goal: a self-serve classifier builder for internal ops teams, alpha in early August.

Milestones: unlabeled-pool prep from LAION-400M in June, embedding precompute in July, internal alpha the week of Aug 3. Note Q3 OKR planning locks 2026-06-26 — I want the alpha on that list.

Dmitri
